title: Sexual and reproductive health and rights: infographic snapshot: North Macedonia 2021

sections.title: Page 1

summary.text: Introduces the 2021 sexual and reproductive health and rights infographic snapshot for North Macedonia, explaining that it summarizes national data across the life course. It notes that comprehensive, people-centred services need an enabling environment, quality health systems and community engagement, and that much data is limited or gender-binary.

sections.extract: This country snapshot provides an overview of national data relating to sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) throughout the life course. Realization of SRHR requires provision of comprehensive, people-centred services, that address the different elements of SRHR, and which are supported by an enabling environment, quality health systems, and meaningful community engagement. Multiple, synergistic

summary.text: Presents North Macedonia's demographic, sexual and reproductive health and HIV indicators, including population, life expectancy, age distribution, fertility, adolescent births and child marriage. Many indicators are marked as having no data, and a legend shows progress against global targets.

sections.title: Page 3

summary.text: Summarizes North Macedonia's laws and policies affecting sexual and reproductive health and rights, covering people living with HIV, gender-based violence, abortion, adolescents and key populations, rated as supportive, partial or punitive. Many entries are marked as having no data, and the page calls for harmful laws and practices to be changed.

summary.text: Gives North Macedonia's indicators on universal health coverage, including essential service coverage, catastrophic health spending, absence of UHC legislation and numbers of doctors, nurses and midwives. It stresses that comprehensive sexual and reproductive health services are an essential part of UHC.

summary.text: Presents HIV prevention and testing data for North Macedonia, including the 95-95-95 treatment cascade, PrEP, self-testing and syphilis, much of which is marked as no data. It also addresses sexual health and the right to safe and pleasurable sexual experiences free of coercion and violence.

sections.title: Page 8

summary.text: The first page of endnotes for the North Macedonia infographic snapshot, explaining the April 2021 data cut-off and that 'no data' means none was found in international sources. It then lists the year, indicator definition and source for each data point, mostly from UN and SDG databases.

sections.extract: The cutoff for data included in this Infographic Snapshot is 15/04/2021. The year provided for each endnote is the date of the latest available data with an earliest date of 2011. Where data is not available in an international data source ‘No data’ is stated. This does not mean that no data exists for this indicator but that no data was found in internationally validated data sources. 1. Starrs, A. M. et al (2018)

sections.title: Page 9

summary.text: Continues the endnotes for the North Macedonia snapshot, giving the year, indicator and source for each data point on gender equality, HIV attitudes, universal health coverage and laws on gender-based violence. Sources include the World Economic Forum, UNAIDS and UN statistical databases.

sections.title: Page 10

summary.text: The final page of the North Macedonia snapshot, with a pointer to WHO self-care resources, a publisher disclaimer from the inter-agency working group on SRH and HIV linkages and remaining endnotes. Endnotes cover key population indicators such as condom use among prisoners, several with no known source.
